Add a participant by dialing out (spends money — requires --yes)

Usage:
  plivo voice multiparty participant add <mpc_uuid_or_name> [flags]

Flags:
      --from string   source number for the dial-out (required)
  -h, --help          help for add
      --role string   participant role: agent|supervisor|customer (default "agent")
      --to string     destination number to add (required)

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts
